title: The skills and the Codex README say what the agent does while a run goes on
name: The skills and the Codex README say what
description: Once `run` has its new shape, `plugins/skills/next/SKILL.md` and `plugins/skills/loop/SKILL.md` must tell the agent how to get from starting a run to reviewing it on every host — wait on the call, or follow it with `logs`/`board` until it ends — without re-running a node that is still going. Add one line to `packages/codex-plugin/README.md` under 'What is different from Claude Code' about the host's tool-call limit and how SOBER handles it. Regenerate with `pnpm plugins`; `test/integration/plugin.test.ts` must pass.

brief.approach: Update source plugins/skills/next/SKILL.md run step and plugins/skills/loop/SKILL.md Running section: `run` is normally blocking under the configured host timeout; if this host ends the tool call first, consult `board` and `logs` for the same node until it is `in-review` or failed, and never call `run` again while it is `running`. This follows the answered decision to keep run blocking and raise the configured Codex tool limit; it adds recovery guidance for hosted clients that still cap calls. In packages/codex-plugin/README.md, add one concise sentence under the existing tool-call timeout paragraph explaining that a hosted call may time out while the underlying run continues and `board`/`logs` are the safe continuation path. Run `pnpm plugins` to regenerate packaged skills. The first run's implementation is already present in its worktree; only repair if checks find a defect. No run implementation or timeout config changes.

acceptance.run: pnpm plugins && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/integration/plugin.test.ts
acceptance.proves: Generated host skills match their sources and the plugin contract remains valid.
Changed documentation and generated files contain no whitespace errors.

plain.what: Tell agents how to follow a run after a host cuts off the tool call, and state the Codex limit in its README.
plain.why: A timed-out tool call can leave the node still running, so repeating run would start the wrong recovery path.
plain.check: Regenerate plugin files, run only the plugin integration test, and check the diff for whitespace errors.
plain.risk: Documentation only; a hosted client's own limit can still end the visible tool call.
